title: RolexJoinMessage
description: A clean and professional join/quit message plugin with Hex color support, LuckPerms integration, and multi-world announcements.
body:
RolexJoinMessage is a clean and professional plugin designed to enhance your server's first impression. It provides fully customizable join and quit messages with support for Hex colors and PlaceholderAPI.

Key Features:

Hex Color Support: Use modern colors to match your server's theme.

PlaceholderAPI Integration: Show player ranks, prefixes, or any other data in messages.

Multi-world Support: Set different messages for different worlds or lobbies.

Lightweight: Built to be efficient without causing any server lag.

Requirements:

PlaceholderAPI (Must be installed!)

LuckPerms (Recommended for displaying ranks/prefixes)

Vault (Recommended for prefix compatibility)
